reason: I only really hate the water when I'm in hotels a few times a year, and $68 up front for a bottle from a brand I've never heard of is a lot on my budget. The creator using it on camera doesn't tell me the filter actually removes anything.
objection: How do I know the filter actually does anything? Nothing here says what it takes out or shows a lab test, and I'd be paying for refills every couple of months mostly to sit in a drawer between trips.
would_change_my_mind: Independent lab results showing what the filter removes, plus a bottle-only price under about $35 without having to sign up for a filter plan.
